title: CLB RF and Depth Canister Internal Metalwork
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE NAVY.NAVSEA.NAVSEA WARFARE CENTER.NSWC PHILADELPHIA DIV
description_text: The Naval Surface Warfare Center, Philadelphia Division (NSWCPD) is seeking to procure internal metalwork in support of CLB RF and Depth Canisters. This procurement is being conducted as a Firm Fixed Price (FFP), Total Small Business Set-Aside, issued using Simplified Acquisition Procedures. NSWCPD intends to procure CLB RF and Depth Canister Internal Metalwork in accordance with NAVSEA drawings. The procurement includes the following items: Description Quantity Spacer, RF Canister 12 Insulator, Take-Up, RF Canister 12 Frame, RF Canister 12 Spacer, Canister, RF Canister 120 Shield, Connector, RF Canister 12 Canister Frame Assembly 24 Spanner Nut, Connector 48 Standoff, Threaded 72 Due to the subject matter of this requirement, interested parties must adhere to the following request process: Method: Request for Quotation (RFQ) requests must be submitted via email only. Required Documentation: Submit a copy of your DD Form 2345 Joint Certification Program (JCP) Certificate. Subject Line: Please reference solicitation number N6449826Q5142 and CLB RF and Depth Canister Internal Metalwork. Fulfillment: Once the JCP Certificate is verified, the RFQ and associated drawings will be sent to the point of contact provided. Please submit all JCP forms and any questions to Karen Morris at karen.l.morris49.civ@us.navy.mil. Phone calls will NOT be accepted.
